content.summary: Comprehensive trace analysis of the calculator subtract function specification, including current vs desired state analysis, component mapping, data flow documentation, and architectural boundary identification.

components.currentBehavior: Exports add(a, b) and multiply(a, b) functions only. No subtract function exists.
components.desiredBehavior: Should export subtract(a, b) function that returns a - b, handling negative numbers and decimals correctly.
components.gap: Missing subtract function implementation. Need to add: export function subtract(a: number, b: number): number { return a - b; }

components.currentBehavior: Generates subtract function to test-full-stack/calculator.ts successfully using LLM
components.desiredBehavior: Same behavior, but should also validate the demo calculator has subtract function
components.gap: Test only validates test-full-stack/ output, not demo-live-integration/ calculator

components.currentBehavior: Validates output using pattern matching (checks if 'subtract' string exists)
components.desiredBehavior: Should validate functional correctness using AST parsing or functional tests
components.gap: Weak validation - only checks string presence, not function signature or correctness

components.currentBehavior: Performs direct file write using Bun.write() without atomicity guarantees
components.desiredBehavior: Should use atomic write pattern (temp file + rename) to prevent corruption
components.gap: Data integrity risk - partial writes possible on crash
